cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Talk Around the Mess
cards.instruction: Keep attention on minor details so no one addresses the larger responsibility you avoided.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved blue labels for the moving boxes. You may suggest a shade.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we pack them first? You haven't put anything inside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Packing follows label approval. You may compare these two blues; confusion on moving day is unacceptable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The driver's outside. He wants to start loading.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: His request is under consideration. You may ask which blue he finds easiest to read; then I'll approve the first empty box.

reason: Give B an active packing request and the driver a loading goal, both redirected through A color approval to avoid the larger unperformed task.
